name: 1C + Cleverence project-bootstrap + requirements-first registry-driven development pipeline
principle: A new project is discovered before task implementation: inventory actual inputs, establish durable project conventions/delivery constraints from evidence, request only material gaps, then prove the task functional contract and technical rules. The reviewing LLM is itself an adversarial surface: every material protection must be challenged for shortcut/bypass paths. Gates never disappear. Tier-0 rules always require disposition. Final readiness is decided only by requirements_gate + release_gate.

sequence: when only the skill repository URL is available, identify it as UNIVERSAL_SKILL_REPOSITORY rather than target project/baseline
inventory every supplied target repository/archive/directory before source suffix filtering
classify artifact family/role/layout or keep it explicitly UNKNOWN/MIXED
inspect actual project source for conventions and modification policy before asking the user
request only unresolved material project facts/artifacts
persist durable evidence-backed facts in PROJECT_CONTEXT
do not treat repository access as proof of deployed baseline, runtime or delivery workflow

when customer configuration evidence is not already sufficient, derive TEMPLATES/PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_REQUEST.json from the accepted requirement and unresolved proof dependencies before asking for a broad configuration export
pre_task_bootstrap.blocking_semantics: Open project fields block only the actions they control. Source analysis may continue while AUTHOR_MARKER values or delivery details are unresolved. For applicable 1C implementation, AUTHOR_MARKER_BLOCKED forbids development entry; reuse bound values and ask only still-missing ФамилияИО / Дата value-or-policy / НомерТЗ. ПервыйБит and the default marker shape are Skill-owned. Exact delivery still requires an authoritative baseline/layout.

bounded_work_policy.scope: Non-trivial authorized work control inside the existing development pipeline; not a scheduler, iteration ledger, conversation state machine or platform execution boundary.

bind_before_additional_exploration.rule: Before another query, read or test for an accepted task, bind these five items so exploration has a finite claim-centred exit rather than an open-ended search goal.

material_progress.definition: Evidence is material progress only when it changes an existing accepted obligation or uncertainty enough that the next engineering choice changes.
does_not_count: repeated green result on unchanged bytes
novelty unrelated to the accepted outcome

bounded_evidence_plan.rule: Use a small finite query/read/test plan for the bound claim.
bounded_evidence_plan.extension: Extend only for a source-anchored dependency necessary to the accepted task and give every extension a finite exit condition.
bounded_evidence_plan.novelty: Material novelty outside the accepted outcome becomes a follow-up candidate; it does not automatically widen current scope.

repeat_and_stall.rule: Cosmetic rephrasing is not a new reason to repeat search/read/test. After repeated non-progress, reassess source/strategy and allow one bounded discriminating retrace or strategy change for the same claim.
repeat_and_stall.stall: If the retrace still does not advance the claim, preserve unresolved state, close independent work and return the smallest exact evidence/input/experiment request.

focus.rule: Active investigation normally focuses on one causal question; a second active question is allowed only for discriminating comparison.
focus.obligations: Focused investigation never drops required writers, lenses, paired flows, routed obligations or acceptance checks; those remain in the existing queue and are handled sequentially.

user_checkpoint.rule: An internal goal or phase boundary is not a user checkpoint. Continue autonomously through routine authorized discovery -> design -> implementation -> validation -> delivery.
return_only_for: material implementation fork not decidable by accepted policy/evidence

validation_reopen.rule: A validation failure reopens only the affected or invalidated closure. After a material fix, reroute and re-evaluate dependent obligations/fingerprints; do not reopen all discovery by default.

delivery_projection.rule: Delivery and documentation project settled current Implementation Intent/change_items/evidence. Reopen only an exact dependency contradicted by current evidence; do not rediscover settled facts merely to render final artifacts.

interrupted_mutation.rule: After interrupted mutation, apply RECOVER_FIRST_NOT_REPLAY_FIRST and reconcile durable/native state before any retry.

platform_boundary.rule: This policy does not reset stream/cache/history, guarantee wall-clock execution bounds, preempt model reasoning or create a platform execution boundary.

actions: read README_FIRST.md then the README/SKILL bootstrap kernel for a cold chat; do not load the full registry/reference/archive into LLM context for ordinary task work
run TOOLS/artifact_corpus.py and TOOLS/build_project_bootstrap.py for a new/unfamiliar target project or materially new artifact family
let executable tools consume RULES/rule_registry.json and load only routed profiles/references into model context
use build_review_plan --summary for compact LLM/human routing while preserving the full plan in --output
for skill maintenance run cold-start, LLM anti-bypass, artifact/bootstrap, provenance, review and validate_skill suites
bind exact user/deployed baseline and candidate hashes
bind artifact family/role/layout and authoritative configuration root when delivery depends on physical shape
never substitute ARCHIVE/current-work history or bundled reference for target deployed baseline
when baseline is supplied, bind a deterministic file/tree SHA-256 snapshot into plan and ledger dependencies
build TOOLS/build_requirements_contract.py from task/source/project evidence before non-trivial design
do not repeat durable project-bootstrap questions inside every task contract
infer known task facts first; ask only unresolved blocking gaps that can change behavior, ownership, scope or acceptance
run TOOLS/requirements_gate.py; REQUIREMENTS_BLOCKED forbids production-ready technical design
record need → target outcome → behavior/rules → acceptance traceability
scale depth by risk: R1 adds invariant/source-of-truth/scope, R2 adds process/state/repeat/errors, R3 adds full integration contract

when a material requirements gap can be resolved by a concrete missing artifact, request the smallest sufficient artifact and keep the affected gate blocked until it is provided or independently resolved

when a human-readable requirements/specification artifact is applicable, render a separate Функциональная спецификация.docx through TEMPLATES/REQUIREMENTS_ARTIFACT_TEMPLATE.md and TOOLS/render_user_artifact_docx.py only after canonical requirements status is known; omit truly empty conditional sections and never upgrade the requirements gate
run TOOLS/build_review_plan.py with --requirements-contract for non-trivial change work
planner consumes the shared artifact corpus so nested containers and semantic Cleverence paths participate in routing
requirements/project context may widen surface/raise risk but never downgrade source detection
Tier-0 technical disposition remains mandatory
use the compact plan summary to decide which profiles/knowledge to load; do not manually read the complete registry for routine work
actual target first
physical inventory precedes analyzable-source filtering and includes nested containers/runtime artifacts
uncertain behavior => search the exact target first, then use public DISCOVERY_ONLY catalogs to locate the nearest typical/BSP/vendor source family and request the smallest exact source closure
build local exact-source indexes ephemerally from supplied target/user-authorized source; retained INTERNAL_FULL sources/indexes are optional maintenance oracles and never public-runtime dependencies
register source/version/hash and artifact-layout dependencies
for routed 1C XML artifacts run TOOLS/analyze_onec_xml.py on the smallest corpus that preserves companion metadata/form/XDTO context before inferring structure
for Cleverence distinguish semantic Operations/Metadata/DocumentTypes from their physical Configuration/Documents.zip/subset representation
missing decisive source => request the smallest dependency closure explicitly; do not guess, silently narrow scope, or stop at an unrequested evidence gap

for customer environments without a stable local contour, prefer request-driven ProjectSnapshot acquisition: entry objects + evidence categories + smallest sufficient dependency closure, then issue delta requests only when analysis discovers a new material dependency

treat collector backend capability as evidence scope: RUNTIME_METADATA cannot prove unavailable source text or exact configuration bytes; missing/unsupported requested items remain explicit EVIDENCE_REQUIRED

run TOOLS/plan_project_snapshot_collection.py against the explicit customer-contour backend set before collection; use PARTIAL/BLOCKED rows to request only the missing evidence class and never upgrade runtime visibility into unavailable source evidence

delegate ProjectSnapshot user interaction, collector delivery, package binding, source inspection and task resumption to WORKFLOW/PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_CHAT_ORCHESTRATION.json; do not maintain a second state machine in this pipeline
stages.description: Build factual artifact inventory and artifact-role/layout evidence before narrowing scope from file/archive labels.

actions: use the accepted functional contract as the business boundary for design
prove ownership, identity, I/O/call/data flow, trust boundaries and alternatives before code
apply evidenced project modification/attribution/comment conventions from PROJECT_CONTEXT
for multi-field invariants create case matrix and align it with acceptance cases
before a parallel business chain, map source dimensions through the standard pipeline and prove actual semantic loss
for each changed invariant name established_by, relied_on_by and justified defensive rechecks
create ledger from plan; generated proof rows start unresolved
copy artifact_model/artifact_delivery_state from the plan as intake dependencies
for change-work whose artifact cannot support exact delivery, seed a blocking request for the authoritative artifact and rebuild plan/ledger after it is provided
every routed rule/check needs evidence or reasoned NOT_APPLICABLE
treat proof-row IDs as unique identities; reject duplicate rows rather than collapsing them
use concrete {kind, ref} evidence; MACHINE/RUNTIME evidence must link named report/case records
resolve proof_policy only from RULES/rule_registry.json; ARCHITECTURE_SEMANTIC claims require verifier-confirmed EXACT_SOURCE plus content-bound INDEPENDENT_REVIEW
treat generic SOURCE/SEMANTIC receipts and self semantic reasoning as supporting-only for ARCHITECTURE_SEMANTIC; editable proof/trust/status fields cannot promote them
keep absent external reviewer provenance explicit: CONTENT_SESSION_SEPARATED reduces correlated self-review but is not cryptographic/external independence without a trusted adapter
read KNOWLEDGE/GAP_DISCOVERY_PROTOCOL.md and run the registry-defined lenses independently from active profiles and machine findings
retain only source-anchored falsifiable hypotheses with a concrete counterexample and falsifier
search the current registry for an owner before declaring COVERAGE_GAP
keep EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, CONFIRMED_DEFECT and COVERAGE_GAP blocking; machine zero cannot close discovery

before any applicable 1C source mutation, final implementation code generation, delivery patch construction or manual-transfer implementation step, require AUTHOR_MARKER_READY from the existing Project Context/bootstrap/comment-policy contract; AUTHOR_MARKER_BLOCKED permits analysis/requirements/source inspection/evidence acquisition only, reuses bound values and asks only still-missing values

before source mutation/final implementation generation, run the existing TOOLS/implementation_intent.py pre-mutation admission against review plan + Validation Ledger; require IMPLEMENTATION_ADMISSION_READY derived from ANALOG_BEFORE_INVENTION existing_capability_disposition, while IMPLEMENTATION_ADMISSION_BLOCKED permits analysis/source inspection/evidence acquisition only; AUTHOR_MARKER_READY remains an independent required admission
build and maintain the canonical Implementation Intent Map bound to exact baseline/candidate/requirements/review-plan identities
trace each material change requirement → design decision → artifact/fragment → entrypoint/caller → acceptance case → nearest smaller applicable alternative → verification hooks
for Cleverence trace MSLX Action scenario/writer/state and field producer → mapping → Mobile field → writer/router/Core → consumer; unknown Action/writer remains an evidence gap
minimal coherent diff
preserve encoding/style and evidenced PROJECT_CONTEXT conventions
do not refactor existing project/customer/third-party code or rewrite existing attribution/comments unless the task requires it and project policy permits it

before constructing final implementation artifacts, select/confirm one primary development result mode from explicit user request, project modification policy, target/source topology, proven authorized mutation/import mechanism and exact validation boundary; technical ability to generate XML does not imply IMPORTABLE_ARTIFACT; when accepted 1C application is manual in Configurator/extension, direct mutation is unavailable/not authorized and no exact validated import route exists, default to MANUAL_TRANSFER_INSTRUCTION

bind development output to the accepted ProjectSnapshot identity/baseline and assemble it as a ChangePackage whose manifest traces every material change item to target, payload/instruction, dependencies and verification hooks
stages.description: Prove every new behavior-affecting routine is connected to an intended runtime entrypoint/caller path; Export/existence alone is not integration.

actions: independent CODE_TO_STANDARDS from meaningful changed constructions
independent STANDARDS_TO_CODE expanded from every routed registry rule/check
do not infer reverse-pass completion from local PASS labels; unresolved/missing reverse rows block release
after material fix logically rerun dependency closure and invalidate changed evidence dependencies
reuse prior evidence only through explicit {kind, id, fingerprint} dependencies; changed dependency identity invalidates reuse
review L1-L6
prove client/server, persistence, concurrency, security, update safety and platform/vendor semantics
for multi-BSL change-sets run TOOLS/analyze_changeset_architecture.py and complete semantic responsibility/owner mapping even when it reports zero candidates
for meaningful custom assignments run field-aware temporal review: same field + reachable later writers; same-module keyword co-occurrence is not evidence
enforce derive → validate → mutate for derived business keys
L4-L6 architecture claims use the registry-owned semantic proof policy and content-bound separated review; exact source proves bytes/provenance, not interpretation
assume the implementation defect remains and construct empty/duplicate/retry/partial/concurrency/large-volume/out-of-scope counterexamples
treat the LLM/reviewer itself as a shortcut-seeking actor; read KNOWLEDGE/LLM_ADVERSARIAL_VALIDATION.md
for each material safeguard hypothesize how scope, risk, evidence, baseline, artifact role, N/A status or runtime proof could be laundered
maintain TESTS/LLM_BYPASS_MATRIX.json and run TESTS/run_llm_bypass_regression.py
attack each newly added defense through at least one second representation/path before calling it hardened
run routed BSL/field-flow/change-set/signature/1C-XML/Cleverence analyzers on exact final bytes
Cleverence analyzers and planner must consume the same bounded artifact corpus/layout normalization
machine PASS is not semantic/runtime PASS
treat external structural heuristics as supporting evidence; promote to blocking only after source/official-contract confirmation and calibration on a known-working corpus
for non-trivial 1C mechanisms independently verify current official standards and freshness
use KNOWLEDGE/EXTERNAL_SOURCE_CATALOG.json to preserve source roles: cc-1c-skills/v8std on demand, lt-review provenance archive only
validate exact transfer bytes, manifest/encoding and deployed caller/consumer closure
derive physical delivery shape from the accepted target baseline rather than a bundled reference or hardcoded Configuration/ layout
FULL_COMPARE preserves the exact authoritative baseline shape and changes only allowlisted bytes; never copy runtime DB wholesale into configuration delivery
UNKNOWN/MIXED/runtime-only intake cannot be relabeled merge-ready without resolving authoritative delivery and rebuilding the plan
when recorded origins are accessible, release gate rehashes current candidate/baseline bytes to detect post-plan drift
run release gate
validate the exact delivered artifact according to its selected result mode; result format changes packaging/handoff semantics, not implementation completeness

for MANUAL_TRANSFER_INSTRUCTION require separate Инструкция по внедрению.docx; chat-only code is incomplete delivery; the object-first instruction must bind exact target/baseline and boundaries, material negative constraints when applicable, exact metadata/code and placement anchors, ordered deployment sequence, verification matrix with expected results, final static-control checklist, changed-object map, and no silently delegated material implementation choice

keep artifact readiness separate from applied-target proof: an instruction, patch/diff, source set, compare set or importable package cannot by itself prove target bytes, deployment success or runtime behavior that was not observed
validate TEMPLATES/CHANGE_PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json semantics: exact source snapshot/baseline binding, result mode, change-item traceability and proof boundary

retain post-transfer verification hooks and changed-object snapshot scope in ChangePackage; default policy is OPTIONAL, so absence of PostTransferSnapshot does not block artifact readiness unless PROJECT_CONTEXT says REQUIRED_BY_PROJECT

project the validated result through WORKFLOW/RESULT_DELIVERY_CONTRACT.json; the user-facing presentation must not upgrade the canonical gate outcome, source proof, applied-target state, deployment/import state or runtime evidence

render required user-facing documentation artifacts as separate DOCX files through KNOWLEDGE/USER_ARTIFACT_DOCX.md and TOOLS/render_user_artifact_docx.py; every non-trivial implementation requires separate Особенности реализации.docx and MANUAL_TRANSFER_INSTRUCTION additionally requires separate Инструкция по внедрению.docx; do not combine unless the user explicitly requests a combined/alternate format

when MANUAL_TRANSFER_INSTRUCTION is selected, render the separate mandatory Инструкция по внедрению.docx through TEMPLATES/MANUAL_TRANSFER_INSTRUCTION_TEMPLATE.md; its core remains object-first Создаваемые объекты -> Изменяемые объекты -> Код and ChangePackage remains the machine delivery/proof owner

for every non-trivial implementation, render separate mandatory Особенности реализации.docx through TEMPLATES/IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES_DOCX_TEMPLATE.md with exact five owner header fields and exact five owner table columns
render separate Построчное обоснование изменений.docx through TEMPLATES/LINE_BY_LINE_JUSTIFICATION_DOCX_TEMPLATE.md only when the user explicitly requested it

when COLLECTION_ALGORITHM is routed, project the canonical exact-candidate Performance Review through RESULT_DELIVERY_CONTRACT as supplementary output; STRUCTURAL_ONLY must say `Измеренное ускорение не доказано.`, MEASURED requires verifier-confirmed RUNTIME_ADAPTER evidence, and the projection must not alter implementation_readiness, release_outcome or any separate DOCX artifact proof boundary
execute representative runtime cases when available
otherwise preserve RUNTIME_PENDING
classify project-only facts, proven reusable facts, new failure classes, validator opportunities and workflow changes
extend an existing owner rule instead of duplicating it
update durable PROJECT_CONTEXT when a project convention/source/delivery fact was established
record PROMOTED, PROJECT_ONLY, NO_REUSABLE_KNOWLEDGE or EVIDENCE_PENDING
for promoted lessons regenerate views and rerun complete validation
only after accepted runtime evidence promote a maintained baseline

learning_definition_of_done: Every substantive task receives a knowledge-extraction disposition. A reusable lesson is integrated only when it can be routed, reviewed, regression-tested and blocks unsupported release. Every new material safeguard is also challenged for an LLM shortcut/bypass path.

rules: interrupted chat/stream/tool/transport/LLM response means completion UNKNOWN, not failure
before replaying any material action, reconcile matching durable artifacts/evidence and exact native state
local long-running command recovery is delegated to the existing TOOLS/execution_checkpoint.py owner with the same exact operation identity

external non-idempotent mutation requires exact native-state read-back before retry; matching completed mutation resumes at the next owner, definitely absent mutation may retry through its normal owner, ambiguous state fails closed with the smallest exact verification and no blind replay
read-only result is reused while still valid or re-read from the authoritative source when freshness requires
resume from the first genuinely uncompleted canonical owner/stage and never require restatement of already-bound task/project/requirements solely because the response timed out
